description: For startups looking for customers: the 10 best-fit buyers for a company, with the reason for each. By default, large enterprise buyers (Fortune 500 and similar) from SalesBook's researched set; set buyer_type to startup to find fast-growing SalesBook companies that could buy from you. Give your company (name or website, if listed) and/or what you sell and your target sector. Experimental: fit uses public, company-level signals only. To be considered for an introduction, use opt_in_for_intros.

buyer_type.description: enterprise = large buyers (default); startup = SalesBook companies that could buy from you (for vendors selling to startups)

company.description: Your company name or website (optional if you describe what you sell)

sector.description: Target sector, e.g. healthcare, retail, manufacturing, education, financial services

what_you_sell.description: One or two sentences on your product and who it is for

name: find_prospects
title: Find best-fit enterprise prospects
